notes: The bottom of a core no longer looks like a cup. The end it stands on faces the table, so no photo ever sees it, and the 3D model had closed it with a guess a few millimetres up inside the core (Adnoc Sample 5: 1.8 mm, and 4 % of the volume missing). It is now filled flat at the table, so height, volume, slices and levelling are the core's. Older scans are checked by themselves; the scan page says what was done, with a switch to turn it off
To scan that end for real: Dimensions only now offers "Flip it and scan the bottom too" after the first ring, as Dimensions + detail already did
Nothing you start is lost: a scan stopped or interrupted before its first photo is kept as a draft too, with its Sample ID and settings
A Sample ID is remembered as soon as it is typed, not only when the scan starts
